company.shortDescription: Sohar International specializes in personal, business banking and wealth management.
company.description: ​Sohar International is a financial institution that offers a wide range of services, including retail and corporate banking, investment services, and treasury operations. The organization provides products such as personal and housing loans, credit cards, insurance, and digital banking solutions. It operates through multiple segments, including wholesale, retail, government and project finance syndication, investments, and treasury.
